description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for Veeam Backup & Replication syslog events. Extends the upstream SC4S Veeam_MP routing stub with conservative metadata, fixtures, Splunk knowledge, and explicit validation gaps grounded in public Veeam and Exabeam parser evidence.

event_families.label: Veeam Backup & Replication job/activity syslog events

normalized_fields.job_id: Veeam JobID structured-data value where present
normalized_fields.job_type: Veeam JobType structured-data value where present
normalized_fields.job_description: Veeam JobDescription structured-data value where present
normalized_fields.platform: Veeam Platform structured-data value where present
normalized_fields.veeam_flags: Veeam Flags structured-data value where present
normalized_fields.veeam_event_version: Veeam Version structured-data value where present

supported_transports.label: TLS syslog RFC5425
supported_transports.notes: Recommended production transport; Veeam documents TLS and optional octet-counted framing.

supported_transports.label: TCP syslog RFC5424
supported_transports.notes: Supported by Veeam; use only when TLS is unavailable or terminated elsewhere.

supported_transports.label: UDP syslog
supported_transports.notes: Veeam supports UDP, but it should be treated as lab/legacy due to event loss risk.

source_log_version.name: Veeam Backup & Replication syslog integration
source_log_version.notes: Official archived 12.x documentation current for build 12.3.2.4465 provides the event example and field table. Additional real-version replay evidence is required before validated promotion.

validation.source_log_version: Veeam Backup & Replication 12.x official syslog documentation plus public parser schema evidence; synthetic-equivalent fixtures only
validation.evidence: Pack artifacts and fixtures are curated from public Veeam Help Center syslog documentation, upstream SC4S veeam_vbr parser/docs inventory, and ExabeamLabs public Veeam_MP parser schema. Live Veeam replay and Splunk read-back evidence is not yet captured; keep quality_status=curated and trust_level=unverified.

test_event_sets.label: Veeam Backup & Replication RFC5424 structured-data fixtures

timestamp_policy.primary_timezone: offset included in fixture timestamps; source-defined in production
timestamp_policy.notes: Official Veeam documentation states TIMESTAMP follows RFC3339. Fixtures include explicit offsets.

field_delimiting.escape_policy: Synthetic fixtures exercise quoted strings, apostrophes, GUIDs, and backslash user names; additional real-event escaping edge cases are needed before validated status.
field_delimiting.notes: Treat each physical line as one event; Veeam may omit MSG when details are present in structured data.

source.reference: Upstream SC4S generated entries veeam_veeam_md and veeam_vbr; Veeam Help Center syslog integration documentation; ExabeamLabs Content-Library-CIM2 public Veeam_MP parser schema.
source.notes: Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent and use documentation/sample GUIDs plus example.test/RFC-safe identities. No proprietary or customer samples are included.

curation.notes: Selected as a high-value backup/security operations source from upstream SC4S inventory, rotating away from recent firewall pack additions. Public official example events and parser schema are sufficient for conservative curation but not validation wording.

action.notes: ActivityType is present in public parser evidence; Description is used as fallback.

signature_id.notes: Veeam event instance identifier from structured data.

user.notes: May be absent on system-generated events.

session_id.notes: Job or task session identifier used for VBR activity correlation.

object.notes: Veeam job/object context where present; may be a display label rather than a globally unique object identifier.

change_type.notes: Structured Veeam job/platform/version context preserved for analyst triage; not a complete Veeam event taxonomy.

cim.notes: CIM mapping is intentionally partial and focused on job/activity observability.

activity_name.notes: Mapped from Veeam activity type when present, otherwise the event description.

actor.user.name.notes: May be absent on system-generated events.

metadata.original_event.notes: Raw SC4S/Splunk event should remain available for source-shape review.

metadata.product.version.notes: Veeam structured-data Version token when emitted by the source event.

metadata.labels.notes: Veeam job and platform context retained as helper metadata; not normalized to a complete OCSF class.

ocsf.notes: Optional OCSF mapping is not complete.

event.action.notes: Best-effort action label for job/activity events.

user.name.notes: May be absent on system-generated events.

event.dataset.notes: Pack-scoped Veeam Backup & Replication dataset identity.

event.kind.notes: Preserved Veeam structured-data context for analyst filtering; not a full ECS categorization.

ecs.notes: Optional ECS mapping is not complete.

data_structures: Veeam Backup & Replication job started structured-data event
Veeam Backup & Replication job completed structured-data event

explicit_gaps: Real Veeam Backup & Replication server, product build, backup job estate, collector wrapper delivery, and source-local timezone behavior are not proven by this harness
TCP/UDP syslog production variants remain deployment variants; this disposable harness exercises the included dedicated TLS/RFC5425 listener helper
Field validation with retained real product/source-version telemetry requires sanctioned Veeam samples or a non-production VBR test feed

source_delivery.notes: Veeam documents syslog integration; native SC4S-compatible delivery.
source_delivery.validation_status: metadata_classification_only; does not imply live replay/read-back validation

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: native syslog listener or relay-to-syslog path; preserve the pack sourcetype/source routing and validate listener framing locally. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: native syslog listener or relay-to-syslog path; preserve the pack sourcetype/source routing and validate listener framing locally. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.
